name: @w6w-apps/clearout
description: Verify emails (instant and bulk), find professional emails, reverse-lookup people and companies, validate names and resolve domain MX/Whois with Clearout.

w6w.longDescription:
Clearout is a data-quality engine for go-to-market workflows: it checks whether an email address will actually be delivered, finds the professional email of a person at a company, and enriches a contact from an email, a LinkedIn profile or a domain.

A workflow can verify a single address in real time (status, safe-to-send, disposable, free, role and gibberish flags, a suggested correction), run one targeted check such as catch-all or business account, or upload a list for bulk verification and poll it to a result file URL. It can find an email from a name and a company, read back a search that timed out and was queued, run the same as a bulk list, look a person up from an email or LinkedIn URL, look a company up from a domain, validate a name for profanity or gibberish, autocomplete a company into domains, and resolve a domain's MX and Whois records. Account credits, plan and rate limits are readable for free.

The connection holds a Clearout API token (Developer > API in the Clearout dashboard), sent as a bearer token. Verification, finder and lookup calls spend credits; the vendor's `*@example.com` test addresses (for example valid@example.com) do not.
